description: 09:45 - 11:00: Performed 20 bar pressure test down DP/BELOW EZSV plug from cement unit. Pressure leaked off slowly. Meanwhile filled hole with trip tank pump, filled 10,61 m3. Montored well on TT, 11 m3/hr static losses. No change in pressure on cement unit.
